update.title: Auto Clicker supports 100,000 clicks
update.description: Hoilday's floating Auto Clicker now supports runs of up to 100,000 clicks, with Chromebook-friendly Space or letter/number hotkeys.

history.title: Hoilday Auto Clicker
history.description: Added a floating Auto Clicker available across Hoilday pages. Set the interval, click count, and start/stop hotkey; it clicks the Hoilday element under your pointer.

history.title: Legendary catch celebrations
history.description: Newly unlocked Legendary collectibles now trigger a full-screen celebration with a falling collectible, glowing effects, and sparkles.

history.title: Christmas text color in regular fishing
history.description: Regular fishing now has a 0.5% chance to unlock the undecorated Christmas (Base) text color during the Christmas season, with alternating red and green letters.

history.title: Christmas season starts November 27
history.description: The seasonal fishing update now begins November 27 (UTC), replacing Fall and Turkey with Gingerbread and Reindeer, and switching quests and ring fishing to their Christmas rewards.

history.title: Geometry Dash app
history.description: Added Geometry Dash Lite to the Hoilday home screen as a full-screen app. The game runs in an isolated frame and loads its Unity assets from an external CDN.

history.title: Topps app and swipeable home screens
history.description: Added a new Topps app with a red-and-white storefront, release countdowns, shop purchases, deliveries, collecting history, help content, and a Rufus-only admin manager. The Hoilday app grid now uses swipeable pages with page indicators instead of creating extra rows, and the admin can delete shop items and release-calendar entries.

history.title: Thanksgiving Feast cooking app
history.description: A new Thanksgiving cooking app counts down to its 4:00 PM Eastern unlock on November 23, then stays open through November 27. Complete 24 ordered prep, seasoning, and cooking steps across eight dishes to earn a turkey-decorated text color, Harvest Feast ring, Turkey and Pumpkin emojis, Candy Canes, Gummy Bears, Gingerbread people, and fish.

history.title: Separate Christmas apps
history.description: The Advent Calendar and each unlocked Holiday feature now appear as separate home-screen apps. Rufus previews large, gold-framed reward cards directly in Admin.

history.title: Advent Calendar and Christmas apps
history.description: Added 25 daily rewards for December 1–25, an Advent preview for Rufus, Holiday fishing and shopping, collectible text colors, and Christmas tree rooms.

history.title: Snowball fishing rank
history.description: Added Snowball to the fishing odds and rank collection. This Legendary rank has a 0.01% chance on each regular fishing cast.

history.title: Christmas Weather
history.description: Admins can turn on global Christmas Weather with a red-and-green theme and falling Christmas trees. The Christmas countdown now has even more glowing red and green lights.

history.title: Trade with members and restore backups
history.description: Choose recipients from member dropdowns and trade only for collectibles they own, including complete collections; trades complete immediately. Restore a backup to the matching signed-in account without changing its password.

history.title: Gifts and fair trades
history.description: Send ranks, emojis, and rings to other members or exchange collectibles through trade offers. Transfers are verified by the server, trade exchanges happen together, and each account keeps at least one rank.

history.title: Turkey fishing and profile rings
history.description: Fish for eight collectible profile rings, equip your favorite on your avatar, and take your ring collection along in account backups. Candy Cane uses a custom-drawn striped icon.

history.title: Your new Hoilday home screen
history.description: Hoilday now opens to an iPad-style app home screen with animated app launches, account export and separate-account import, and a release history. Your existing calendar, messages, settings, profile, admin, reporting, fishing, and emoji fishing features are still here.

history.title: Cameron rank and Camel Weather
history.description: Cameron is a 0.2% fishing catch. Admins can enable Camel Weather for everyone with camel-orange styling and raining spinning camel emojis.
